body:
> Let's have all the `splash_screen` options under advanced settings.

I don't think it should be an advanced setting because it's a very useful feature for mobile devs and it would be changed for most projects.

Setting a image as the background doesn't work on all devices. I've tested with multiple devices but it never worked for me.
From [this report](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/100513) ,it seems like it works on some devices but then it's confusing because one don't expect `icon_background` to change spash screen.
I still don't think using `icon_background` is a good idea, but to maintain the current behavior I've updated the logic. It now defaults back to `@mipmap/icon_background`.
